Upside Down Peach Cake

Click to rate
/50 reviews Be the first to rate

By exemple Laurance

Prep
30 min
Cook
35 min
Total
65 min
Servings
6 people
Difficulty
Easy

Ingredients

  • 7-8 large white or yellow peaches
  • 200 g sugar
  • 165 g salted butter
  • 225 g flour
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 tsp liquid vanilla

Instructions

[élidé — I9]

Peel them and cut them into large pieces. Place them in a saucepan with two tablespoons of sugar.

Cook them for 5-7 minutes over medium heat.

They will release a little juice, that's perfect! Pour them into the dish.

Make the batter by mixing the sugar and the butter.

Add the flour, the eggs and the vanilla.

Mix well, then pour over the peaches.

Bake for 35 minutes at 170°C. Adapt the baking to your own oven!

To be enjoyed warm or cold!

Bon appétit !
